cc:Work.dc:description: The 11 measured density/VP/VS rows are the regression inputs. Calculated pressures are excluded. Curves replay the audit's explicit finite-strain room-temperature approximation, including K0T in L2/M2. Residuals and displayed RMS cover all 11 velocity rows; the separately recorded audit RMS covers only the ten high-pressure rows, excluding the ambient anchor. The catalog's isothermal K0/K0′ are derived from this acoustic fit; their parameter comparison remains separate.
